meta.title: Directive 8020 Co-op: Crossplay No, Friend Pass No, Split Screen Yes
meta.description: Crossplay: no, not announced. Friend pass: no, each player needs a copy. Split screen: yes on Steam, with caveats. Online co-op supports up to 5 players.
meta.ogTitle: Directive 8020 Co-op: Online, Split Screen & 5 Players
meta.ogDescription: Online co-op arrived free on 19 October 2026: up to five players, each needing their own copy. Split screen, PS Plus, crossplay status and platform limits explained.

hero.h1: Directive 8020 Co-op | Local Players, Online Play & Platforms
hero.intro: Plan your group around the platform and mode you will actually use. An online feature on one store does not establish the same capability on every version.

sections.heading: Is Directive 8020 split screen? Yes on Steam, with caveats

blocks.text: Yes — Steam lists shared/split-screen co-op, though the store category does not confirm simultaneous split-screen play. Xbox lists local co-op for 2–5 players, and PS5 lists 1–5 players.

rows: Confirm mode and group setup in the installed version
1–5 players; up to five online players
PlayStation Plus is required for online play
Check the current Xbox page separately for online features

sections.heading: Is Directive 8020 crossplay? No — not announced

blocks.text: No — crossplay has not been announced. The release describes up to five players but makes no cross-platform claim; Steam’s shared/split-screen category also does not establish simultaneous split-screen play, and online co-op does not prove a free friend pass.

items: Check the current page for every participant’s platform.
Update the game and confirm the intended mode appears in your version.
Review purchase, account and subscription requirements before inviting friends.
Use the actual on-screen controls for assigning characters and starting the session.

sections.heading: Does Directive 8020 have a friend pass? No

blocks.text: No — there is no friend pass: each player must own their own copy of the game. The free 19 October 2026 update added online multiplayer to the PS5, Xbox Series X|S and Steam versions, and up to five players can connect from separate locations.

items: Custom Mode — the traditional couch co-op experience, brought online.
Round Robin Mode — control passes between players at set intervals.
Choice Voting — the group sees who voted for what, then follows the majority or breaks ranks.
No crossplay has been announced: the release describes up to five players but makes no cross-platform claim.
